purpose: Manual public-image diagnostic, not a fitted 3D target, recognition, likeness score or acceptance gate.
alignment: Two pupil centers: translation, uniform scale and rotation only. No anisotropic resize, shape warp or retouch. Individual inputs untouched.
coordinate_system: Pixels, original image, origin top-left. Approximate manual picks; do not turn into exact anatomical ground truth.

canonical_portrait.role: High-resolution existing cartoon identity portrait; not the 145px upscaled turnaround crop used in older boards.

a7.role: Existing actual native A7. Not new geometry. Lens/light differ from 2D canonical art; pupil gaze is not a perfect skull registration.

limits: References are stylized 2D images, not a calibrated multi-view scan. Camera, gaze, expression and lighting differ.
Only clearly visible features annotated. Hair-occluded skull/cheek/body contours are deliberately not invented.
Compare ratios as diagnostic clues, then inspect neutral native clay in multiple views. Do not blindly set 3D vertex targets from this single picture.
No private photographs, screenshots, filenames or photo hashes are included.
